Job specifications:
Associate Consultant - EYParthenon
FY2025

Executive - EY Parthenon
LI
About EY Parthenon
EY-Parthenon aims to create a unique world-class strategy practice that delivers long-term
value to our clients, our people and EY. As a sub-service line within Strategy and
Transactions, it brings together professionals with diverse strategic capabilities and deep
sector insights. EY-Parthenon enables our professionals to lead from the front, unlock the
full potential of strategy, transactions and restructuring, and reshape work, paving the way
for major transformation programs, and driving measurable impact to the rest of EY. EYParthenon plays a critical role in driving collaboration between sub-service lines, within
service lines and across the firm.
The opportunity
EY Parthenon is looking for a suitable member for our team in Strategy practice. The role
provides an opportunity to be part of the team which assist businesses in setting strategic
goals and identifying the steps to meet them, analyse industry dynamics such as market size,
growth, and share of leading competitors, identify the business’ unique competitive advant
age and help create alignment among all business units and functions to support and enhance this positioning. Team offers clients with Business Model Reinvention, New Market
Entry Opportunities and Digital Strategy and Innovation
Your key responsibilities
•
•
•
•

•

•
•

Understand client issues and assist businesses in setting strategic goals and
identifying the steps to meet them
Assist team with commercial due diligence which is to analyze market dynamics
including the size and growth of an industry as well as the individual target’s
positioning, potential growth levers, risks, and opportunities
Assist with new strategy formulation which includes evaluating opportunities for
growth including entering new geographies, offering new products and services, or
serving new customer segments
Assist with solutions revolving around Digital Strategy and Innovation by assessing
the clients underlying digital business models, explore avenues for new growth, both
organically and inorganically, and construct the roadmap to build, grow and
transform the organization for the digital world
Offering Go to Market Strategy by identifying opportunities to improve how
products and services reach customers including but not limited to decisions related
to route-to-market, channel selection, pricing optimization, and customer
segmentation
Assisting Transaction integration services by deploying a holistic integration program
that addresses topics such as people, value, control, execution and technology is
imperative
Assist the project team to in help clients improve portfolio management, divestment
strategy and execution

2

FY 2025

•
•
•

Also assist the project team in pre deal analysis and Due Diligence by synergy
identification, validation, planning and delivery tracking. Also focusing on
operational due diligence and IT due diligence
Responsible for a specific workstream in the project
Responsible for contributing towards knowledge sharing portals to build the
practices intellectual property

Skills and attributes for success
•
•
•
•
•
•
•
•
•
•
•

Demonstrated ability to deliver on complex assignments
Experience in delivering business strategy and diligence projects in complex
environments
Strong quantitative skills for data analysis, interpretation of output, and generation
of insights
Research oriented mindset
Should have an eye for detail
Ability to flex individual styles and work back with diverse teams
Strong communication skills – oral and written (in terms of making presentation)
Strong financial modelling skills and clarity of financial concepts
Desire to contribute and succeed in a fun, exciting, collegial, and challenging
environment
Proficient in the English language both in writing and verbally, in a professional
environment
Willingness and ability to travel

To qualify for the role, you must have
•

Engineering graduates (from premier institute) with a good academic background

Ideally, you’ll also have
•
•
•
•

Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and
negotiation skills.
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility.

What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple
client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a
practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver
insightful and practical solutions.

3

FY 2025

What working at EY offers
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible
working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to
deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing
your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel
regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help
you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
About EY and SaT
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the
finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world.
That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative
freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional
EY experience lasts a lifetime.
EY Strategy and Transactions teams work with clients to navigate complexity by helping
them to reimagine their eco-systems, reshape their portfolios and reinvent themselves for a
better future. Whether they are a corporate, private equity, government, sovereign wealth
fund, private or family business, or educational institution client, we help with all their key
strategy and transaction decisions.
